findings.title: `_require_instance` is duplicated across `markets.py` and `instruments.py`
findings.description: `instruments.py` defines `_require_instance(value, expected, field)`, and `markets.py` defines a byte-for-byte equivalent. The only difference is the exception class, `InvalidInstrumentError` versus `InvalidMarketError`. The project rule says "Do not duplicate logic". `markets.py` also carries a `_require_nonempty_str` that `instruments.py` re-implements inline for `instrument_id`, with a slightly different message. Both modules are deliberately kept free of `canonical` and `calendars` imports. A small shared validation helper in a new module (for example `core_model/validation.py`) could take the error class as a parameter. That would keep the boundary and leave one place to change the message format. The `test_import_boundary` module list would need to include the new module.

findings.title: Unhashable inputs raise `TypeError` instead of `InvalidMarketError`
findings.description: `Market.__post_init__` tests `self.source_bar_stamping not in SOURCE_BAR_STAMPINGS`. `_normalize_bases` calls `frozenset(bases)`. If a caller passes an unhashable value, such as a list as the stamping or a list element among the bases, Python raises a raw `TypeError` instead of the module's typed `InvalidMarketError`. The tests only cover hashable wrong types such as `7`, `"raw2"` and `"adjusted"`. This only affects calls that already break the static types, so it is low priority. If the runtime-guard contract is meant to be total, add `_require_instance(self.source_bar_stamping, TimeMeaning, ...)` before the membership check. Do the same per-element check before building the frozenset.

findings.title: Fixture calendar and market data stay consistent by construction
findings.description: The fixtures take calendar ids from the fixture calendar objects, so a market cannot name a missing calendar. `FIXTURE_CALENDARS` is keyed by each calendar's own id and wrapped in `MappingProxyType`. Tests check that keys match ids and that the mapping is immutable. `test_fixture_market_calendar_ids_resolve` covers the market-to-calendar link. The extended-hours fixture is tied to the regular fixture by the shared-session-dates test and the UTC-to-local table rows. The golden-hash rows are described as computed independently from the canonicalization rules, not from `canonical_hash` output. This is a sound approach and needs no action.

findings.title: Exception handling, typing and style conform to the Python rules
findings.description: The four new error types subclass `CoreModelError`. No `try/except` blocks were added, so there are no swallowed exceptions. The code uses built-in generics and `|` unions. Types are hinted throughout. The dataclasses are frozen and slotted. The enums are `StrEnum`. Constants are defined once (`SOURCE_BAR_STAMPINGS`, `_CURRENCY_CODE`). The ruff selection in `pyproject.toml` includes `BLE`, `ASYNC` and `B`, and pyright runs in strict mode. File and function sizes are within the ~300-line and ~50-line targets.
